- Added new skill "redfin-mcp" for natural-language access to Redfin listings, property records, market reports, and saved homes/searches via MCP.
- Requires the redfin-mcp server and the fetchproxy browser extension for authenticated, private API access using your own browser session.
- Supports multiple tools: property search, detailed property info, market reports, local mortgage calculator, and access to your saved Redfin homes/searches.
- All tools are read-only; actions like saving homes or searches are not yet implemented.
